skill.name: zhihu-search-api-skill
skill.description: Search Zhihu articles through the BrowserAct API, then extract article metadata and full body content for research and monitoring workflows.
skill.summary: Searches Zhihu with BrowserAct and returns structured article details and full content.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally uses outbound BrowserAct API calls and reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY for authentication. Most Markdown command findings are false positives from inline code formatting, but the skill includes unsafe guidance to have users provide an API key and language that frames CAPTCHA and geo-fencing avoidance as benefits.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide the BrowserAct API key in chat. Require users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in their local environment or secret manager.
Remove claims about avoiding CAPTCHA, IP restrictions, or geo-fencing. Add guidance that users must follow Zhihu and BrowserAct terms of service.
Clearly disclose that keywords, task metadata, and returned content are processed by BrowserAct over the network.
Document safe argument handling and avoid constructing shell commands from untrusted user text.

content.value_statement: Zhihu research can be slow when users need current articles and full text. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to return structured Zhihu article data.
actual_capabilities: Runs the included Zhihu search script with a keyword, date range, and result limit.
Starts a BrowserAct workflow from the configured template ID.
Polls BrowserAct until the task finishes, fails, or times out.
Returns article title, body content, image URL, author, publication date, and source link.
Supports date filters for 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, one year, or all time.
Reports missing or invalid BrowserAct API key errors.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and outbound network access.
Depends on BrowserAct workflow availability and Zhihu result accessibility.
Search terms and task data are processed by BrowserAct.
Results may take several minutes and are limited by the configured count.

use_cases.title: Track Industry Trends
use_cases.description: Find recent Zhihu articles about a market, technology, or policy topic for a research brief.

use_cases.title: Monitor Brand Mentions
use_cases.description: Collect recent Zhihu coverage about a company, product, or campaign for reputation review.

use_cases.title: Gather Competitor Signals
use_cases.description: Search Zhihu for competitor product updates, interviews, and public discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for articles about renewable energy from the past 7 days. Return titles, authors, dates, links, and short summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Brand Monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for mentions of Acme Robotics from the past 30 days. Highlight recurring themes and any negative coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Market Research Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 15 Zhihu articles about AI agents from the past 90 days. Group the results by use case and audience.

prompt_templates.title: Comparative Intelligence Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for the past year about three named competitors. Compare product claims, customer concerns, and notable source links.

output_examples.input: Search Zhihu for generative AI from the past 7 days.
output_examples.output: A concise list of recent Zhihu articles with titles, authors, publication dates, original links, and extracted body content.

output_examples.input: Monitor a brand name for the past 30 days.
output_examples.output: A brand mention brief that groups articles by sentiment themes, source accounts, publication dates, and relevant links.

output_examples.input: Find competitor updates from the past 90 days.
output_examples.output: A research digest with article summaries, competitor names, product signals, and links for follow-up reading.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment before running the skill.
Use focused keywords, a clear date range, and a practical result limit.
Review original links before citing findings in reports or decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat prompts or shared transcripts.
Do not use the skill to collect private, restricted, or unauthorized information.
Do not run broad all-time searches without a clear limit or review plan.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches Zhihu articles through a BrowserAct workflow using a keyword, date range, and result limit.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment before the script can run.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return title, body content, image URL, author, publication date, and original article link.

faq.question: How long can a search take?
faq.answer: The script may run for several minutes because it starts and polls a BrowserAct workflow.

faq.question: Can it summarize results?
faq.answer: Yes. The agent can summarize extracted articles after the BrowserAct workflow returns content.

faq.question: What should users check before publishing findings?
faq.answer: Users should review original Zhihu links, respect source terms, and avoid exposing API keys.
